descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
The Stream Reporting team is responsible for capturing and processing the consumption signals that power some of Spotify’s most important experiences and business functions. Our systems help ensure accurate royalty reporting, support experimentation and analytics, and provide trusted data that informs recommendations and personalization across Spotify.
We’re looking for an Android Engineer to join a highly collaborative team working at the intersection of mobile development, data, and platform systems. This is an opportunity to build software that operates at Spotify scale and helps power experiences used by millions of listeners every day. You’ll help shape how listening and engagement signals are captured across Spotify’s mobile experiences and transformed into trusted datasets used throughout the company.

The Stream Reporting team is responsible for capturing and processing the consumption signals that power some of Spotify’s most important experiences and business functions. Our systems help ensure accurate royalty reporting, support experimentation and analytics, and provide trusted data that informs recommendations and personalization across Spotify.

We’re looking for an Android Engineer to join a highly collaborative team working at the intersection of mobile development, data, and platform systems. This is an opportunity to build software that operates at Spotify scale and helps power experiences used by millions of listeners every day. You’ll help shape how listening and engagement signals are captured across Spotify’s mobile experiences and transformed into trusted datasets used throughout the company.

lists.content:
• Develop and maintain mobile client components that capture and report listening and user behavior signals across Spotify.

  • Build high-quality, well-tested, and well-documented Kotlin code that contributes to business-critical datasets used for royalty reporting, analytics, experimentation, and personalization.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Android, iOS, backend, and data teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

  • Help improve the architecture, reliability, and quality of the systems used to collect and process user behavior signals.

  • Contribute to new capabilities that enable Spotify to capture richer listening and engagement signals across evolving product experiences.

  • Drive technical improvements that make it easier for teams across Spotify to add, validate, and maintain event reporting integrations.

  • Use modern AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows to improve productivity and software quality.

  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence.

• You have experience developing Android and iOS applications using Kotlin using Swift or Objective-C

  • You have solid experience as a Engingeer I

  • You know how to build maintainable, scalable, and well-tested software systems.

  • You are comfortable working within large codebases and can quickly learn unfamiliar domains and technologies.

  • You have experience collaborating with engineers and stakeholders across multiple teams.

  • You care about code quality, testing, documentation, and long-term maintainability.

  • You demonstrate curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to step outside your immediate area of expertise when needed.

  • You are comfortable using modern development tooling, including AI-assisted coding solutions.

  • You thrive in environments where learning and long-term growth are valued.

  • You might have experience with C++ and understand how native code integrates with Android and iOS applications.

  • You might have familiarity with SQL, analytics systems, or data engineering concepts.

  • You have experience with instrumentation, telemetry, event collection, or large-scale client-side data systems.

  • You have worked on mobile applications that operate at significant scale and reliability requirements.

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The Artist & Label Partnerships team are the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors. Please note this is a fixed-term, 6 months, contractor role hired through a third party.

lists.content:
• Maintain positive partnerships across artist and label communities within Vietnam.
  • Support our key partners in Vietnam on Spotify tools, resources and insights.
  • Work closely with our cross functional teams to support artists and labels on priority releases in Vietnam
  • Collaborate with the regional Music team to ensure content strategies are localized and successfully executed.
  • Ensure Spotify has the best possible content offering in Vietnam and use this to further Spotify’s appeal to existing and new users.

• You have at least 3+ years of working experience in the music/entertainment industry. Regional and global experience would be an added advantage. 
  • Extremely well organized, dedicated with the ability to plan, deliver on tight deadlines and pay outstanding attention to detail.
  • You have a deep understanding and established network within the local music industry in Vietnam and have built relevant contacts with labels and artists to effectively collaborate with the community.
  • You have a strong background in music and technology and a consistent record with operations.
  • You have a strong grasp of content knowledge, music and cultural trends, artists, user engagement and behaviors. 
  • You have excellent stakeholder management skills. 
  • You have experience working within Vietnam and ideally across multiple markets within regional and global teams.
  • You are very fluent in written and spoken English and Vietnamese. 
  • And finally, a great teammate, adapt well to change, and always have a positive demeanor.
• This contract is based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify’s end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.

We’re looking for a strategic-minded, execution-oriented Artist & Label Partnerships Manager for the Maghreb region, covering Morocco, Algeria, and Tunisia. You’ll join Spotify’s Music team in the Middle East, North Africa, Turkey & Pakistan (MENAT+) region and report to the regional Head of Music.

You’ll sit at the heart of the music ecosystem, moving between high-level release strategies and the day-to-day work that drives artist and business growth. You’ll build trusted relationships across the industry, bring deep knowledge of the Maghreb music landscape to Spotify, and help artists and partners make the most of our platform. Your work will strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice across the Maghreb.

lists.content:
• Be a primary Spotify partner for artists, labels, and other music partners across Morocco, Algeria, and Tunisia, building relationships that support artist development and long-term growth
  • Develop and execute a holistic music strategy for the Maghreb that aligns with regional business goals and reflects the momentum of the region’s evolving music scene
  • Build impactful artist partnerships and lead creative, cross-functional initiatives that strengthen artist-to-fan engagement both on and off Spotify
  • Identify emerging artists, music trends, audience behaviors, and cultural movements across the Maghreb, bringing actionable insights to the MENAT+ team, global counterparts, and partners across Editorial, Artist Marketing, Consumer Marketing, Licensing, and other teams
  • Support and educate artists, labels, and their teams on Spotify tools, resources, and insights, helping partners get more value from the platform
  • Work closely with regional Editorial teams and Genre Groups on priority releases and content opportunities, while representing Artist & Label Partnerships in high-impact regional and global projects
  • Connect Spotify teams with the music industry to identify and execute opportunities for Spotify and our partners, while helping ensure we have a compelling content offering across the Maghreb
  • Travel regularly to Morocco, Algeria, and Tunisia to build relationships and stay closely connected to the region’s music communities

• You have 7+ years of experience in artist and label partnerships within a digital music service, record label, media, technology, or related music industry organization
  • You have a deep understanding of the music ecosystem across Morocco, Algeria, and Tunisia, with established relationships across artist and label communities
  • You understand Spotify’s role in the music industry and can combine strong cultural judgment with data and audience insights to inform strategy and tell compelling stories
  • You stay close to emerging music and audience movements across the Maghreb, from Moroccan pop, rap, and chaabi to Algerian raï, Tunisian alternative scenes, and the sounds shaping what comes next
  • You’re a confident communicator and storyteller who can present to senior stakeholders, advocate for the market, negotiate effectively, and build alignment across different teams and perspectives
  • You’re comfortable owning complex projects in a fast-changing environment, balancing strategic priorities with hands-on execution and bringing strong organization and attention to detail
  • You have experience working across regional and global teams and can navigate global-to-local structures while keeping partners and cross-functional teams aligned
  • You’re fluent in English and French. Arabic, including Darija and/or other Maghreb dialects, is strongly valued, as are additional languages relevant to the region

• This role is based in Dubai
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

You will sit at the heart of the music ecosystem, moving between high-level release strategies and the day-to-day tactical execution that drives artist and business growth. This role is perfect for a music industry professional who thrives on building relationships and navigating the intersection of technology and creativity.
 
Our ideal candidate has fun at work and a desire to make a positive impact on the music industry as a whole. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape. This role is based in Taipei and will require international travel occasionally.

lists.content:
• Focusing on the Taiwan music landscape, You will be the primary point of contact for local and global music partners based in Taiwan, ensuring that Spotify remains the most valued partner for artists and our industry partners, utilising on-platform promotion and off-platform marketing to ensure Spotify is the premiere platform for artist development
  • Develop and execute a holistic music strategy for Taiwan that aligns with regional business goals
  • You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, executing on creative and cross-functional collaborations in the region and beyond, building impactful and innovative artist partnerships to enable artists and artist-fan engagement
  • You will proactively identify music trends, emerging talent and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, providing deep cultural and musical insights with the local SEA team to execute pivotal initiatives, your global counterparts on multi-market campaigns and other key internal partners & teams including editorial, artist marketing, consumer marketing, licensing and others
  • Support and educate our key partners across artists and labels communities in Taiwan on Spotify tools, resources and insights to encourage them and improve their daily business
  • Lead artists & label partnerships representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets at both a regional and global level
  • Ensure Spotify has the best possible content offering in Taiwan and use this to further Spotify’s appeal to existing and new users
  • Work with regional Editorial teams and regional Genre Groups on high priority releases, as well as other cross-functional teams to progress towards various content objectives
  • Connect other Spotify teams with the music industry to help drive and execute opportunities driven by Spotify and our partners. You will act as liaison between Spotify and artist / label partners.

• You have at least 7+ years of working experience with label and artist relations in an established digital music service, record label, media or tech company. Regional and global experience would be an added advantage
  • You have a deep understanding and established network within the local music industry in Taiwan and have built relevant contacts with labels and artists to effectively collaborate with the community
  • You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify’s role in the music industry both locally and globally
  • You are skilled at leveraging data and audience insights to support strategic decisions and build clear narratives
  • You are culturally aware, with the ability to critically evaluate music trends, emerging movements and audience behaviour beyond just data
  • You are a confident storyteller and public speaker. You are able to prepare and deliver executive level presentations, effectively advocate for the market and secure stakeholder buy-in with ease
  • You are well organised and detail-oriented with the ability to plan, deliver on tight deadlines and pay outstanding attention to detail
  • You are at ease and have proven experience navigating fast-changing priorities in a dynamic environment, comfortable navigating complex global-to-local organizational structures and aligning cross-functional teams around Music priorities
  • You have strong project management skills with a consistent record in marketing and operations
  • You have excellent negotiation and people skills and consistently demonstrates a positive attitude
  • You have experience working within Taiwan and ideally across multiple markets within regional and global teams
  • Fluent in English and Mandarin. Fluency in regional languages would be an added advantage

• This role is based in Taipei
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 

Spotify's programmatic advertising business is one of the fastest-growing areas within our Ads organisation — spanning audio, video, and display across one of the world's most engaged audiences. This role sits at the center of that growth.

Are you passionate about shaping how brands connect with listeners through programmatic advertising — and ready to lead that charge across the UK market?

We are looking for an outstanding Automation Lead (Programmatic) to join our team. We're looking for someone with a proven record of revenue generation in the programmatic advertising field, with deep relationships across agencies, agency trading desks, and Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs). You bring a passion for online media, data, and ad tech. We want someone who loves our product and understands the programmatic ecosystem.

lists.content:
• Serve as the  programmatic expert and evangelist in the sales organisation, applying our diverse programmatic and data offering to drive revenue via Programmatic Guaranteed, PMP and open auction channels
  • Grow programmatic advertising revenues by creating, maintaining, and sustaining relationships with DSPs, agencies, trading desks and appropriate demand partners
  • Sell programmatic across audio, video and display, with a knowledge of mobile app based programmatic sales
  • Work collaboratively with our sales leadership team on strategic programmatic selling in market, pitching to agency and brands
  • Support and upskill the wider sales team via internal education, co-selling in market, being the go to person for planning and execution
  • Meet and exceed quarterly revenue goals
  • Represent Spotify at events and serve as a brand ambassador
  • Manage activity using salesforce, provide accurate and timely forecasting, and report on meeting activity

• You have 8+ years experience in a programmatic and/or digital media sales role
  • You bring an established personal network in place with senior contacts across the programmatic ecosystem
  • You strategically use data and insights to inform client investment strategy
  • You’ve developed a deep understanding of the digital ecosystem and trends around programmatic technology, best practices, opportunities, and challenges

lists.content:
• Build, maintain, and evolve backend systems that support personalization and recommendations at Spotify scale.
  • Develop infrastructure that enables efficient retrieval, ranking, and filtering of personalized content.
  • Build platform capabilities that support candidate generation and representations of content and users.
  • Design reliable, scalable, and performant services capable of supporting high-volume recommendation workloads.

• We are a distributed workforce enabling our band members to find a work mode that is best for them!

  • Prefer to work in an office environment? Prefer to work from home instead? Not a problem! We have plenty of options for your working preferences. Find more information about our Work From Anywhere options here.

lists.content:
• Identify, structure, negotiate, amend, close, and manage strategic distribution partnerships across APAC that advance Spotify’s growth and long‑term vision.
  • Develop and refine partner strategies for priority markets in collaboration with the regional lead, carrying out detailed partner analysis and setting priorities and forecasts.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for partners, building credibility across all levels—from C‑suite to Marketing to Commercial teams —and owning the full relationship lifecycle.
  • Analyze existing partnerships to unlock additional value, improve performance, and uncover opportunities for expansion.
  • Manage internal approvals including interacting with senior internal executives from relevant functions (e.g., Legal, Finance, Accounting, Product).
  • Drive internal cross‑functional workstreams toward deal objectives, ensuring clarity, alignment, and timely execution.
  • Manage a pipeline of prospective partnerships and assess commercial impact through disciplined analysis and business case development.
  • Travel as needed across APAC to strengthen partner relationships and support deal execution.

• You have a minimum of 5+ years of significant business development or strategic partnerships experience within APAC—ideally across telcos, OEMs, payments, entertainment, or digital platforms.
  • Fluency in English and Korean is required for the role; other additional APAC languages a plus.
  • You have a proven track record of structuring and closing complex deals with large enterprises and scaling partnerships with measurable commercial impact.
  • You understand the nuances of APAC markets and bring relevant local insights; deep experience in Korea, Thailand or Indonesia is especially valuable.
  • You think strategically about complex business issues, yet you’re equally strong in operational execution and relationship ownership.
  • You excel in multicultural, fast‑moving environments and collaborate effectively across distributed teams.
  • You have strong experience negotiating contracts, understanding legal frameworks, and partnering effectively with attorneys.
  • You are comfortable working with product, engineering, and design teams and translate technical concepts to non‑technical team members with ease.
  • You are analytical, data‑driven, and experienced in financial modelling and constructing clear business cases.
  • You communicate with clarity and influence, simplifying complexity for senior audiences internally and externally.
  • You are diligent with strong commercial instincts and the ability to see long‑term value in every opportunity.
  • You demonstrate initiative, resilience, and the ability to independently drive deals from ideation to launch.
  • BA/BS degree with outstanding academic performance; MBA a plus.
  • Experience in using basic AI tools.

• This role is based in either Singapore or Seoul, South Korea.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Desktop Natives squad, part of the Platform & Partner Experience (PPX) Studio, builds and maintains the native layer of the Spotify Desktop app across Windows, macOS, and Linux. We work across the systems outside the shared UI layer, from packaging and delivery to operating system integrations, backend services, release tooling, and the native C++ desktop shell that brings together Client-Core, Chromium Embedded Framework (CEF), and Spotify’s Web Player. Our work sits at the intersection of systems engineering, performance, and user experience, helping Spotify feel seamless and truly native on desktop.

lists.content:
• Contribute to and maintain Spotify’s Desktop C++ application across macOS and Windows.
  • Develop native container capabilities that enable UI teams to build new experiences and take advantage of evolving platform capabilities.
  • Improve platform systems, CI configurations, build pipelines, packaging, and application delivery.
  • Develop and maintain backend services supporting content delivery, update infrastructure, and release tooling.
  • Build and improve operating system integrations, including features that connect Spotify with partner platforms.
  • Collaborate with external partners such as Microsoft to make use of the latest platform capabilities.
  • Contribute to cutting-edge work exploring AI agent integrations within the Spotify Desktop experience.
  • Work closely with a distributed group of engineers and partners to solve complex problems across systems, platforms, and technologies.

• You have strong C++ development skills and are comfortable working on production software with a large user base.
  • You have experience navigating complex codebases that span multiple programming languages, technologies, and systems.
  • You’re comfortable taking ownership of systems through development, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
  • You enjoy solving complex technical problems and can work through ambiguity to find practical solutions.
  • You’re curious about how things work and motivated to learn new technologies, platforms, and areas of the codebase.
  • You collaborate effectively across teams and communicate your thinking clearly.
  • You’re comfortable working with colleagues across a fully distributed team.

• This role is based in Stockholm or London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description:
Spotify is looking for a culturally fluent, strategically sharp, and creative Communications Lead to shape and share our story across MENAT+. You’ll lead communications across the Middle East, North Africa, Türkiye, and Pakistan, helping Spotify strengthen its reputation, champion regional creators, and show up in ways that feel relevant to the audiences and communities we serve.

Reporting to the Head of Communications, SAMEA, you’ll work closely with regional leadership and Spotify’s global communications teams across consumer, corporate, policy, industry, executive, and internal communications. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution and knows how to navigate culturally dynamic, fast-moving markets.

lists.content:
• Shape and execute an integrated communications strategy for MENAT+, putting regional creators, audiences, and culture at the heart of Spotify’s storytelling.
  • Be a trusted communications partner to regional leadership, providing clear counsel on business priorities, reputation, emerging issues, and high-impact moments.
  • Anticipate reputational opportunities and risks and help Spotify respond thoughtfully and effectively as cultural, media, policy, and regulatory dynamics evolve.
  • Lead creator-first and earned-first storytelling that builds fandom, discovery, and cultural relevance, finding compelling stories in emerging scenes, communities, and moments that matter locally.
  • Partner with Music, Podcasts, Product, Growth, Marketing, Public Affairs, and other teams to develop communications that support Spotify’s regional priorities.
  • Connect MENAT+ priorities and perspectives with Spotify’s global communications strategy, while translating global priorities in ways that resonate with local audiences.
  • Lead corporate, executive, internal, and B2B communications, including executive positioning, thought leadership, media engagement, and strategic messaging.
  • Lead agency relationships and budgets with creativity and discipline, developing efficient approaches that deliver high-quality, locally relevant work across a diverse geographic footprint.

• You have 10+ years of communications experience, with experience leading integrated work across consumer, corporate, reputation, and policy communications.
  • You understand the media, cultural, and creator landscape across MENA, Türkiye, Pakistan, or adjacent markets and know how to build communications strategies grounded in local context.
  • You’re a strategic thinker and adaptable storyteller who can work across earned media, executive communications, influencer engagement, and integrated channels.
  • You understand how policy, regulatory, political, cultural, and media developments can shape reputation and can turn that context into thoughtful communications advice.
  • You’re fluent in English and Arabic and/or Turkish, with the ability to communicate effectively with audiences, media, and stakeholders across the region.
  • You bring sound judgment to sensitive or fast-moving situations and can give senior leaders clear, considered advice when the stakes are high.
  • You’re comfortable working across a global, cross-functional organisation and can build alignment, share context, and influence without relying on formal authority.
  • You’re curious about music, creators, culture, technology, and the changing media landscape, and you bring a collaborative, resourceful, and hands-on approach to getting great work done.

• This role is based in Dubai
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
Visual Merchandising shapes how content looks and feels across the Spotify experience. We create the artwork, visual systems, and creative frameworks behind Spotify Playlists, Share Cards, Video Titles, Podcasts, and Audiobooks—bringing the world's largest audio platform to life for hundreds of millions of listeners every day.
As AI transforms how creative teams imagine, develop, and produce work, we're looking for a visionary Creative Lead to define what's next. This is an opportunity to shape the future of visual storytelling at Spotify by combining world-class creative leadership with emerging technologies, ensuring every visual experience remains unmistakably Spotify while inspiring audiences around the world.

  • You have experience building, leading, and developing exceptional creative teams while creating an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.
  • You understand how emerging technologies—including generative AI—are transforming creative strategy, production, and design systems, and you're excited by the opportunities they create.

descriptionPlain:
The Music Mission enables music creators to grow, engage, and monetize their fan bases on Spotify. Central to the Music Mission's vision is the development of promotional tools for artists and label teams, powered by Spotify's deep knowledge of listener behavior. Products like Discovery Mode, Marquee, Showcase, Music Videos, and Clips help artists and their teams grow their audiences, connect with fans, and achieve their goals on Spotify.
We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Discovery Mode within the Music Mission. Discovery Mode is a tool for artists and music marketers designed to help find new listeners when it matters most. With Discovery Mode, artists and labels identify songs that are a priority, and our systems use that signal to inform the algorithms that power personalized recommendations. This role sits within the ML squad that builds and operates the models behind Discovery Mode's measurement system, and you'll serve as the squad's analytical lead.
In this role, you'll partner closely with product managers and ML engineers to evaluate and improve the models that power Discovery Mode. You'll tackle complex analytical problems by designing experiments, developing evaluation frameworks, and building the analytical foundations that help keep our models accurate, reliable, and impactful for artists. As part of the Product Insights team within Music Mission, you'll help shape the measurement systems behind one of Spotify's most important promotion products.

lists.content:
• Own the analytical function for the Discovery Mode ML squad, driving evaluation and continuous improvement of the models that power measurement and campaign optimization
  • Partner with ML engineers to develop evaluation frameworks and identify opportunities to improve model performance, reliability, and customer impact
  • Design and execute rigorous experiments to evaluate model quality, measure outcomes, and guide model development
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to assess model performance and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product and business stakeholders
  • Build, maintain, and evolve dashboards that track model health, customer metrics, and program performance
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional partners to align analytical priorities with squad goals and customer needs
  • Contribute to the broader Product Insights community by sharing best practices and helping raise the bar for analytics across Discovery Mode

• You have 4+ years of experience in a data science role and a degree in data science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
  • You have experience measuring customer outcomes, defining KPIs, and connecting analytical insights to product decisions
  • You know how to design and implement A/B tests, understand when experimentation is the right tool, and interpret results with appropriate rigor
  • You have experience evaluating machine learning model performance and partnering with ML engineers to improve model and customer outcomes
  • You are comfortable working in a highly technical environment and collaborating closely with engineering partners
  • You communicate complex statistical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • You have strong data science fundamentals, including Python, SQL, BigQuery, dbt, data storytelling, and experience working within cross-functional product teams
  • You have experience in areas such as advertising measurement, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference at scale

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EST timezone region as long as we have a work location.
  • This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

As part of the Product Insights team, you'll help define the next generation of promotion products for the music industry.

lists.content:
• Work closely with cross-functional teams of data scientists, researchers, product owners, engineers, designers, marketers, and others across the company to develop the next generation of promotion tools for artists.
  • Identify the most impactful opportunities for product development based on user needs, and execute on them diligently and resourcefully.
  • Define metrics and build the dashboards we use to measure the health and success of our products.
  • Partner closely with other data scientists to inform, build and test hypotheses that deliver actionable insights to improve and expand our products.
  • Contribute to a community of data scientists by evolving best practices and learning new skills.
  • Maintain a culture of rigor and data-informed decision-making to drive tangible business impact.

• Demonstrated ability in a similar Data Science role.

  • You have hands-on experience synthesizing insights from data using tools such as Python, DBT, BigQuery, SQL, Tableau.
  • Strong communication skills and value building strong relationships with colleagues and partners as well as the ability to explain sophisticated topics in straightforward terms.
  • You’re a compelling storyteller who can communicate in succinct and inspiring ways to audiences with varied data science experience to influence product or feature decisions.
  • Bonus if you have experience with advertising.

• This role is based in our New York office.

descriptionPlain:
How does a company with thousands of people building hundreds of products stay focused on what matters most? That's the question the Company Planning and Execution (CPE) team works on every day. We design the systems, processes, and insights that help Spotify plan, prioritise, and deliver at scale.
As a Data Scientist on CPE, you'll sit at the intersection of data, strategy, and operations. You'll bring clarity to complex questions by turning operational and strategic information into clear stories, recommendations, and decision frameworks that help leaders and teams act faster and smarter. You'll also explore how AI and automation can change the way people access insights and make decisions.
You'll work closely with data scientists, engineers, PMs, and business partners across the company to help refine how Spotify executes at scale. If you like making sense of ambiguity, care about how organisations work, and want your analysis to shape real decisions, this is the role.

lists.content:
• Formulate hypotheses related to how Spotify plans and delivers, and communicate insights effectively to a range of audiences.
  • Apply analytical techniques — including statistical models and machine learning — to identify trends and generate insights that improve how we work.
  • Build and maintain the data models, pipelines, and dashboards that provide visibility into how Spotify plans and executes.
  • Develop structured narratives and recommendations — not just charts, but the "why" and "so what" — in our semi-annual Planning and Execution Insight reports and recurring briefings.
  • Explore how AI and automation can make insights faster to produce and easier to access across the company.

• Curious about how organisations work — not just the data, but the decisions and systems behind it.
  • 5+ years of experience with a quantitative background in science, economics, engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and comfortable working with multiple stakeholders across levels and functions.
  • Able to take messy, complex datasets and turn them into clear recommendations and stories that land with non-technical audiences.
  • Proficient in SQL and Python, comfortable in BigQuery, and experienced with tools like dbt, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Experience with operational or work management data is a plus.

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best, with 2–3 days per week in the office.

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.
As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect.
We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.

lists.content:
• Lead and develop multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, supporting their growth and impact.
  • Own and drive the technical strategy for a critical platform domain, aligning it with broader company and platform goals.
  • Enable teams across Spotify to build product experiences efficiently by improving the underlying catalog systems.
  • Guide the evolution and modernization of complex legacy systems into scalable, reliable architecture.
  • Partner closely with product and cross-functional leaders to align priorities and drive execution.
  • Improve system reliability and reduce operational friction in workflows that directly impact content availability.
  • Identify and apply opportunities for automation and AI to improve data quality and engineering productivity.
  • Build an inclusive engineering culture where teams continuously improve how they work and deliver.
  • Develop and execute a long-term roadmap that balances immediate priorities with strategic investments.

• You have experience leading engineering organizations through other leaders and scaling teams effectively.
  • You have worked on complex, data-intensive systems where accuracy, consistency, and reliability at scale are critical.
  • You bring strong system design and architectural decision-making experience in distributed systems.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and making thoughtful trade-offs in high-impact environments.
  • You have experience evolving legacy systems and guiding long-term platform transformations.
  • You influence effectively across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
  • You have experience leading distributed teams and creating alignment across locations.
  • You communicate clearly and can explain complex technical topics to a range of audiences.
  • You are curious about how AI and automation can improve systems and workflows and apply that thinking pragmatically.
  • You care about building inclusive, collaborative environments where teams can grow and do their best work.

• This role is based in Stockholm or London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
Spotify's Personalization mission (PZN) is building the single intelligence layer that powers how hundreds of millions of people discover and experience audio. One agent, one reasoning engine, and one taste model, moving to a unified single stack. 
We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Conversation Product Area. The Conversation Product Area is the technical center of gravity for the shift to one Agent, building the shared Agent Engine harness and the evaluation infrastructure that supports it. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify's Personalization mission (PZN) is building the single intelligence layer that powers how hundreds of millions of people discover and experience audio. One agent, one reasoning engine, and one taste model, moving to a unified single stack. 

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Conversation Product Area. The Conversation Product Area is the technical center of gravity for the shift to one Agent, building the shared Agent Engine harness and the evaluation infrastructure that supports it. The Product Area also owns the Search Brain (intent routing and search-driven conversation) the intent-detection and prompt-suggestion platform behind our agentic consumer features like Chat and AI DJ, and the Speak Platform, Spotify's first-party voice team, which spans applied research, production infrastructure, and the character/brand decisions behind every voice Spotify users hear. This is the engineering org where architecture decisions get made that power every agentic surface at the company.

You'll be working with many of Spotify's senior architects, with product leadership in the consumer AI space, and with cross functional partners. The team needs a leader who is as comfortable making critical architectural calls as they are managing the people making them.

lists.content:
• Own engineering execution and technical direction for the Conversation Product Area, including the Agent Engine, the evaluation infrastructure, the Search platform, the AI Voice platform (Speak), and some consumer agentic features built on top of the Agent Engine. This spans production systems at massive scale, applied ML research, and infrastructure that other product areas depend on.
  • Co-lead the Product Area in a paired product/engineering model. You own engineering and deeply partner with a product counterpart that owns product strategy. You’ll operate as a single leadership unit for planning, prioritization, and external representation. This partnership is core to the success of the role.
  • You’ll manage a team of ~70 engineers, with a small team of Senior Engineering Managers and Staff/Principal engineers directly reporting to you. You’ll develop and hold accountable the EM layer running the PA's roughly 9 teams. Your leverage comes through your SEMs and Staff engineers, but you’re ultimately accountable for delivery across the entire product area.
  • Drive the migration of the company’s existing agentic infrastructure onto the shared Agent Engine, in close partnership product teams across the company, balancing migration speed against product teams’ existing roadmap work.
  • Own the technical strategy for Spotify's first-party voice investment: what Speak builds versus buys, how the team organizes and delivers against a market that's commoditizing fast, and how the character/brand voice decisions for agent experiences get made and shipped on their own aggressive timelines.
  • Define and hold the technical bar on evaluation. Build the discipline around building feature-specific judges and datasets and product decisions based on those eval sets.
  • Set and enforce engineering quality standards appropriate to an AI-assisted development era including code review discipline and test coverage especially designed for teams that are increasingly writing code with AI assistance.
  • Participate as a full member of the broader leadership group, co-developing with your peers and executives the operating model for the whole studio across capacity management, project prioritization, studio communication principles, and building a healthy engineering culture in a highly changeable environment.
  • Represent the Conversation PA's engineering point of view in high visibility, company-wide architecture and steerco conversations with senior leaders.

• You are deeply technical, not tech-adjacent. This PA's defining work (a new shared agent runtime and harness, a scaled evaluation system, a voice/speech stack) requires a Director who can evaluate architecture proposals, hold their own in a room with senior ICs, contribute technically in meaningful ways, and make tough tiebreaking and tradeoff calls.
  • You have run large engineering orgs through platform consolidations, migrations, or evolutions, and you’ve had to earn trust by building highly scaled and functional platform technology.
  • You have experience with at least two of: LLM-based agent systems and orchestration, evaluation/eval-infrastructure design (including automated judges and regression suites), large-scale retrieval or search systems, or speech/voice ML systems and production voice infrastructure.
  • You've managed managers, not just individual contributors. You know how to build a management structure that scales.
  • You have a track record of building strong but nimble teams, with experience restructuring, shifting team resourcing, adjusting to fast changing priorities or shifting needs without losing delivery momentum.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas or EMEA region as long as we have a work location.
  • This team operates primarily within the Eastern North America and Central European time zones for collaboration, so we ask that you be located within a time zone that enables regular overlap with the team.

description:
Within the Data Platform studio, we own two critical pillars: our event delivery platform that collects trillions of events per day from producers to consumers, and another, which handles the pseudonymisation of data so Spotify can use data responsibly and in compliance with privacy regulations. These systems sit at the heart of Spotify's data collection and are used by hundreds of teams across the company.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of six experienced engineers distributed across Europe. You'll set the technical direction, ensure the team delivers high-impact work, and - just as importantly - invest deeply in the growth and careers of your engineers. If you're energised by both the technical challenges of large-scale data systems and the human side of building a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you.

lists.content:
• Lead and develop a team of six experienced engineers, with a strong focus on coaching, career development, and creating an environment where people do the best work of their careers.
  • Take accountability for the team's delivery, ensuring clear priorities, healthy execution, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with product and stakeholders to shape the roadmap for event delivery and privacy infrastructure.
  • Drive technical strategy and architectural decisions for systems operating at Spotify scale.
  • Build a culture of ownership, psychological safety, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate across Data Platform and the wider engineering organisation to align on shared goals and dependencies.
  • Manage on-call health, operational excellence, and reliability for the team's services.
  • Actively participate in hiring, onboarding, and growing the team's capabilities.

• You have experience managing teams of senior/experienced engineers and understand that people leadership is your primary craft, not a side responsibility.
  • You have a track record of investing in engineers' careers - running meaningful development conversations, helping people grow into new roles, and creating clarity around expectations and progression.
  • You're comfortable with distributed data systems, event-driven architectures, or data infrastructure at scale - you don't need to write the code, but you can engage credibly in technical discussions and unblock your team.
  • You hold yourself and your team accountable for outcomes, not just activity.
  • You communicate clearly and build trust across functions and time zones.
  • You've worked with distributed teams and understand how to create cohesion and inclusion when people aren't in the same room.
  • You're excited about the potential of AI and LLMs to transform how engineering teams work - whether that's accelerating development workflows, rethinking how data infrastructure is built and operated, or helping your team adopt AI-assisted tooling effectively.

• This role is based in London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Think it, build it, ship it, tweak it" is at the core of Spotify's product development approach. In the Experimentation product area we are providing Spotify and external customers with Confidence, our platform to quickly and safely iterate through ideas, learn from them and make informed decisions for better products.
 
At Spotify, experimentation touches almost all of our functions from marketing via content management to consumer products, and we’re running several thousands of tests every year. Through confidence, we 're sharing all our findings and practices with more companies as a commercial SaaS product.
 
The team you will manage is a skilled and highly engaged group of engineers that are distributed over Europe. As an Engineering manager, you coach them individually and as a team, maintaining their strong team culture and helping them thrive and and grow. Your technical experience provides mentorship and guidelines to the team, which ensures quality and timeliness of your deliveries. Your leadership promotes creativity, collaboration and courage, which forms a kind and productive team with a high bar for quality and pace of delivery.

descriptionPlain:
The Rights Systems team is driving the technical foundations of a step-change for Spotify’s business by enabling the distribution of new forms of content across the platform. This challenge involves detection of rights-protected intellectual property and facilitating rightsholder and creator management of both the rights-protected IP and the secondary content.
The journey ahead will present the team with the chance to collaborate with teams across the company (Content Platform, Financial Engineering, Label Partnership, Licensing, and others) in order to create and present novel content datasets to end-users. As the product matures, the team will stretch as they scale to broader use cases and a larger user base.
Being a cornerstone of the company’s catalog maximization strategy, the rights systems solution space will be an area of investment and growth for the company over the next 2–5 years.

lists.content:
• Manage and support a team of 7–8 engineers developing the core RightsDB, a new foundational database that serves as a centralized repository for copyright and rightsholder ownership data
  • Support ongoing RightsDB work, including enabling new video content to more automatically make its way to platform by implementing a Publishing Deny List (PDL) and ingesting UGC rights via DDEX
  • Provide mentorship, coaching, and technical guidance to team members to help them identify their growth path and develop their skills aligned to their goals
  • Foster a positive, inclusive, and growth-oriented culture where individuals feel empowered and supported in their careers
  • Partner closely with the product manager and cross-functional stakeholders (design, legal, rights operations) to define scope, roadmap, and priorities
  • Ensure alignment between business needs and technical implementation and establish squad technical strategy to support healthy delivery cycles
  • Manage timelines and ensure reliable, timely feature delivery while scaling project ownership across the team
  • Oversee platform operations including performance, security, incident response, and on-call rotations
  • Encourage a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including legal, rights operations, and content, to ensure the Spotify Rights Center evolves with regulatory needs and continues to meet expectations of rightsholders

• You have 1+ years of experience managing software engineering teams, ideally in a product-focused and cross-functional setting
  • You have 5+ years of hands-on engineering experience, including web, backend, or full-stack development
  • You have experience working with web technologies, distributed systems, or cloud platforms
  • You are comfortable managing stakeholders from both technical and non-technical backgrounds
  • You have experience delivering outcomes in a highly collaborative environment
  • You care deeply about user experience, data accuracy, and system integrity, especially in legal or IP-sensitive domains
  • You have a growth mindset and a passion for building scalable systems
  • You support and empower your team to do their best work
  • You have familiarity with the music or media rights domain or similar IP-centric industries
  • You have familiarity with content management systems, legal compliance platforms, or large-scale data pipelines
  • You have familiarity with platform migrations, user access control models, or third-party integrations

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.
  • This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

As the product matures, the team will stretch as they scale to broader use cases and a larger user base.
Being a cornerstone of the company’s catalog maximization strategy, the rights systems solution space will be an area of investment and growth for the company over the next 2–5 years.

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We’re building one of Spotify’s most social and engaging experiences: Jam. Jam brings people together through music, enabling friends and groups to listen in real time, wherever they are. It transforms listening from a solo activity into a shared experience and plays an important role in how Spotify connects users through audio.
You’ll join a cross-functional team working across mobile, backend, and platform technologies to shape how millions of people experience music together.

descriptionPlain:
Are you passionate about combating fraud, safeguarding revenue, and protecting users from sophisticated threats? As Spotify continues to grow and innovate, we are looking for a dedicated Fraud Analyst to join our Revenue Protection Operations team. In this role, you will play a crucial role in enhancing our fraud prevention strategy—ensuring a proactive balance between user growth, revenue protection, and maintaining a safe, scalable platform.
With scale comes complexity. You will focus on tackling payment fraud, chargebacks/disputes, creator onboarding and platform misuse that risks revenue leakage and partner trust. 
As a 12-month cover, you will seamlessly step into our ongoing operations, keeping our momentum strong while bringing fresh perspectives to our workflows. You will work with a global team of world-class business managers, data scientists, product managers, and engineers to build robust operational defenses. If you have a keen eye for detail, strong analytical skills, and a drive to stay one step ahead of fraudsters using cutting-edge technologies, we want to hear from you!
description:
Are you passionate about combating fraud, safeguarding revenue, and protecting users from sophisticated threats? As Spotify continues to grow and innovate, we are looking for a dedicated Fraud Analyst to join our Revenue Protection Operations team. In this role, you will play a crucial role in enhancing our fraud prevention strategy—ensuring a proactive balance between user growth, revenue protection, and maintaining a safe, scalable platform.

With scale comes complexity. You will focus on tackling payment fraud, chargebacks/disputes, creator onboarding and platform misuse that risks revenue leakage and partner trust. 

As a 12-month cover, you will seamlessly step into our ongoing operations, keeping our momentum strong while bringing fresh perspectives to our workflows. You will work with a global team of world-class business managers, data scientists, product managers, and engineers to build robust operational defenses. If you have a keen eye for detail, strong analytical skills, and a drive to stay one step ahead of fraudsters using cutting-edge technologies, we want to hear from you!

lists.content:
• Detection & Mitigation: Review suspicious activity flagged by our fraud systems and take swift mitigating and preventative action to protect our genuine users, secure our growth, and minimize revenue leakage.

  • AI & Tooling Innovation: Actively utilize, test, and adopt emerging AI technologies and automated tooling to enhance fraud detection and improve operational productivity.

  • Build & Optimize: Partner closely with internal Product and Engineering teams as well as external vendors to help contribute to the design, requirement gathering, and testing of tooling and system changes to capture evolving fraud and abuse trends early.

  • Trend Analysis & Investigation: Be creative and proactively seek out new fraud and misuse trends. Present data-informed findings and retrospectives to suggest robust performance guardrails.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Handle daily fraud and misuse escalations while working closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Product teams to translate operational insights into risk mitigation frameworks.

  • Operational Excellence: Support the Revenue Protection leadership in maintaining and improving internal policies, process automation, evidence handling, and operational playbooks.

• Experience: 2+ years of experience in a fraud analyst or revenue protection role, preferably within an e-commerce, merchant fraud, or creator & marketplace platform environment. Given the fixed-term nature of this role, the ability to rapidly adapt and hit the ground running is highly valued.

  • Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with common fraud prevention techniques, dispute/chargeback management, financial crime risks, and emerging industry trends.

  • AI & Systems Mindset: Direct experience working with machine learning and rule-based fraud prevention tooling (such as Ravelin, Sift, Signifyd, Accertify, etc.). You possess the confidence and curiosity to leverage AI technologies to test, scale, and optimize internal fraud detection tools.

  • Data Proficiency: Strong data analysis skills using SQL (knowledge of Google BigQuery is a plus) and experience with dashboard visualization tools like Looker, Tableau, or similar.

  • Analytical Thinker: An ambitious and creative problem solver who works well independently, thrives when handling ambiguity, and can break down complex technical risks into practical applications.

  • Collaborator & Communicator: A highly communicative person with a collaborative mindset who excels at building strong relationships with internal stakeholders, operations, and global partners.

• You'll be based in London, UK.

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
The Subscriptions Mission is shaping the future of how millions of people discover, purchase, and experience Spotify Premium. We build the platforms and tools that power Spotify's global subscription business, enabling new offers, pricing strategies, and commerce experiences that help our business move quickly while delivering exceptional experiences for listeners.
Join the Monaco squad, where we create the internal products that enable Spotify teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers with confidence. From subscriptions and prepaid products to pricing updates and promotional campaigns, our tools support business-critical operations through intuitive experiences, trusted workflows, and reliable platform services.
As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll develop end-to-end solutions spanning modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms. Working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and business partners, you'll help create the tools that enable Spotify's global subscription business to innovate safely, efficiently, and at scale.

lists.content:
• Build end-to-end features across modern web applications, backend services, and data platforms that support Spotify's global subscription business.

  • Create intuitive internal products that enable business teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers through secure, guided workflows.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services that power subscriptions, prepaid products, pricing, promotions, and the offer lifecycle.

  • Develop GraphQL and gRPC APIs that connect frontend applications with distributed platform services.

  • Design efficient database schemas, implement data migrations, and optimize application performance using PostgreSQL.

  • Build secure, reliable, and auditable systems that support business-critical financial operations and SOX-compliant approval workflows.

  • Collaborate with engineers across the Subscriptions Mission to evolve shared platform capabilities, improve developer experience, and increase platform reliability.

  • Write maintainable, well-tested code while contributing to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to help maintain the reliability and availability of services powering Spotify Premium.

• You have experience building and delivering production software across both frontend and backend technologies.

  • You have experience developing scalable backend services using modern Java, with Java 17+ experience being a plus.

  • You have built modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js.

  • You have experience designing or consuming GraphQL APIs and enjoy building schema-driven applications.

  • You have worked with gRPC services and Protocol Buffers, or you're excited to deepen your expertise in distributed systems.

  • You have hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including schema design, migrations, and query optimization.

  • You care about writing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software that delivers long-term value.

  • You enjoy partnering with engineers, designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful outcomes.

  • You have a passion for simplifying complex workflows and creating intuitive experiences for internal users.

  • Experience with tools such as jOOQ, Flyway, Apollo GraphQL, DataLoader, Styled Components, Storybook, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or similar technologies will help you ramp up quickly.

  • Experience building commerce platforms, subscription products, pricing systems, distributed systems, or large-scale platform modernization initiatives is beneficial.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location.

  • This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zones for collaboration.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify’s Global Experiential and Content Production team is seeking an Associate Director with well-rounded content and event production experience to join our team.
While this role sits within Global Communications, the impact is company-wide. You will support multiple functions across the business including Communications, Ads, Government Affairs, Product, Music, Creator, Podcast and Audiobooks teams—to bring their initiatives to life through strategic events and content.
Importantly: this team works alongside Spotify’s Brand Experiential Marketing team. That team owns global consumer and brand marketing events. This team owns a defined set of experiential programs tied to communications priorities, creator/industry relationships, policy moments, company events, VIP/Influencer programming, thought leadership platforms, and other business-driven needs - not all events across Spotify.
As an Associate Director, you will play a key role in delivering high-impact creative content and managing live event production. You will build scalable solutions to maximize the success of these projects and support GECP’s Director in the development, management, and execution of our team objectives and project goals. This is a senior creative and production role, guiding both the experiential work and content creation. 
The role requires significant travel (domestic and international) up to 70%

lists.content:

  • Shape end-to-end event and experiential production, from concept through execution, ensuring high-quality creative and operational delivery.

  • Manage agency and vendor partnerships, selecting and directing the right collaborators based on scale, complexity, and creative needs.

  • Align internal and external teams on creative direction, ensuring a clear vision across visual storytelling and editorial decisions.

  • Build and manage budgets, timelines, and approval processes across multiple concurrent projects.

  • Partner with cross-functional senior leaders to bring ideas to life and solve complex business needs and challenges.

  • Mentor and support direct reports and producers while leading large-scale, high-visibility productions.

  • Navigate legal and licensing requirements related to visuals, talent, and music usage.

  • Oversee content capture shoots, partnering with internal stakeholders from early development through content delivery, ensuring all is on time and within budget.

  • Bring expertise in technical and stage production, including lighting, audio, and production design, to elevate each experience.

  • You are comfortable managing budgets, contracts, and financial reconciliation.

  • You have experience leading both direct reports on a day-to-day basis and production teams on a project basis.

  • You care about building inclusive, collaborative environments and supporting diverse teams and partners.

  • You are able to balance creative thinking with strong organization and prioritization skills.

  • You have a global mindset and can collaborate effectively across domestic and international regions and time zones.

  • You have a strong understanding of content production workflows, including pre- and post-production processes.

• This role is based in New York City
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify is looking for a commercially minded FP&A Manager to serve as the dedicated finance partner for our Distribution Partnerships team. Distribution Partnerships play an important role in Spotify's growth strategy by working with strategic partners to expand user acquisition, deepen engagement, and improve retention through innovative distribution and marketing initiatives.
In this role, you'll build the financial foundations that help shape partnership decisions. You'll develop robust business cases, subscriber models, and end-to-end P&L analyses that connect user growth with business outcomes. You'll partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate opportunities, challenge assumptions, and provide insights that help leaders make confident, data-informed decisions.
description:
Spotify is looking for a commercially minded FP&A Manager to serve as the dedicated finance partner for our Distribution Partnerships team. Distribution Partnerships play an important role in Spotify's growth strategy by working with strategic partners to expand user acquisition, deepen engagement, and improve retention through innovative distribution and marketing initiatives.

In this role, you'll build the financial foundations that help shape partnership decisions. You'll develop robust business cases, subscriber models, and end-to-end P&L analyses that connect user growth with business outcomes. You'll partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate opportunities, challenge assumptions, and provide insights that help leaders make confident, data-informed decisions.

lists.content:
• Lead business case development for Distribution Partnerships by building investment models that combine subscriber forecasts, partnership economics, and full P&L impact.
  • Develop financial frameworks that evaluate new and existing partnerships, including lifetime value, payback periods, return on investment, and other key performance metrics.
  • Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and risks that inform partnership strategy and investment decisions.
  • Partner closely with Distribution Partnerships, Accounting, Business Affairs, Legal, Strategy, and other cross-functional teams to translate financial insights into clear recommendations for business and senior leaders.
  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve reporting for the partnership portfolio, including KPIs, performance tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Support annual planning, quarterly forecasting, and ongoing financial planning activities by partnering with business leaders to establish data-driven targets.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting, and tooling to help Spotify evaluate and manage partnerships more effectively.

• You have 5+ years of experience in FP&A, Strategy & Analytics, Investment Banking, Corporate Finance, or a similar analytical role. Experience in a consumer subscription business is a plus.
  • You have experience building sophisticated financial models and performing scenario analysis in environments with evolving information and changing priorities.
  • You know how to translate commercial agreements into meaningful financial outcomes and have experience partnering with Legal, Business Affairs, commercial, or deal teams.
  • You are comfortable working with large datasets. Experience with SQL is preferred, and you are interested in applying AI tools to improve financial analysis and decision-making.
  • You balance strong attention to detail with sound judgment, knowing when additional analysis will meaningfully improve a decision and when it is time to move forward.
  • You manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining a high standard of quality in a fast-moving environment.
  • You are naturally curious and enjoy exploring problems beyond the initial question to uncover insights that create business value.
  • You communicate complex financial concepts clearly and tailor your recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• For this role, the preferred locations are Stockholm or London. 
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best!  We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

description:
We are looking for a strategic-minded, execution-oriented Artists & Label Partnerships Manager for France, to join Spotify’s Music team based in Paris. In this role, you will sit at the heart of the music ecosystem, moving between high-level release strategies and the day-to-day tactical execution that drives artist and business growth. This role is perfect for a music industry professional who thrives on building relationships and navigating the intersection of technology and creativity.

 

Our ideal candidate has fun at work and a desire to make a positive impact on the music industry as a whole. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape.

lists.content:
• Focusing on the French music landscape, you will be the primary point of contact for local music partners based in France, ensuring that Spotify remains the most valued partner for artists and our industry partners, utilising on-platform promotion and off-platform initiatives to ensure Spotify is the premiere platform for artist development
  • Support and educate our key partners across artists and labels communities in France on Spotify tools, resources and insights to encourage them and improve their daily business
  • You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, executing on creative and cross-functional collaborations in the region and beyond, building impactful and innovative artist partnerships to enable artists and artist-fan engagement
  • You will proactively identify music trends, emerging talent and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, providing deep cultural and musical insights with the local FR team to execute pivotal initiatives, multi-market campaigns and other key internal partners & teams including editorial, consumer marketing, communications, strategy & operations…
  • Lead artists & label partnerships representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets
  • Ensure Spotify has the best possible content offering in France and use this to further Spotify's appeal to existing and new users
  • Connect other Spotify teams with the music industry to help drive and execute opportunities driven by Spotify and our partners. You will act as liaison between Spotify and artist / label partners.

• You have significant experience with label and artist relations in an established digital music service, record label, media or tech company. 
  • You have a deep understanding and established network within the local music industry in France and have built relevant contacts with labels and artists to effectively collaborate with the community
  • You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify's role in the music industry both locally and globally
  • You are skilled at leveraging data and audience insights to support strategic decisions and build clear narratives
  • You are culturally aware, with the ability to critically evaluate music trends, emerging movements and audience behaviour beyond just data
  • You have excellent negotiating, presentation and people skills. You are able to prepare and deliver executive level presentations, effectively advocate for the market and secure stakeholder buy-in with ease
  • You are well organised and detail-oriented with the ability to plan, deliver on tight deadlines and pay outstanding attention to detail
  • You are at ease and have proven experience navigating fast-changing priorities in a dynamic environment, comfortable navigating complex global-to-local organizational structures and aligning cross-functional teams around Music priorities
  • You have strong project management skills with a consistent record in marketing and operations, and feel at ease with digital and AI tools
  • You possess a perfect level of written and spoken English 
  • Finally, you're a great teammate and always have a positive and humble attitude.

• For this role, the preferred locations is Paris. 
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.
