descriptionPlain:
Spotify is looking for a Manager to join our Finance team and serve as a dedicated FP&A partner for our global Payments and Customer Service functions. As Spotify continues to scale across markets and monetization models, payments sit at the heart of how we acquire, convert, and retain subscribers, while customer service shapes the experience and cost of supporting them. This role owns the financial lens on both ecosystems.
This is a high-impact, partner-facing finance role responsible for the payments and customer service forecast processes, the financial evaluation of payment partner and processor deals, the pipeline of payment optimization proposals, revenue protection and payment-cost assurance, and the modeling of contact center labor needs. You will partner with Payments, Customer Service, Subscriptions, Risk, Data, Financial Engineering, Accounting, and Business leadership to translate complex operational economics into clear financial narratives, build the models that inform decisions, and govern performance against plan.
description:
Spotify is looking for a Manager to join our Finance team and serve as a dedicated FP&A partner for our global Payments and Customer Service functions. As Spotify continues to scale across markets and monetization models, payments sit at the heart of how we acquire, convert, and retain subscribers, while customer service shapes the experience and cost of supporting them. This role owns the financial lens on both ecosystems.

This is a high-impact, partner-facing finance role responsible for the payments and customer service forecast processes, the financial evaluation of payment partner and processor deals, the pipeline of payment optimization proposals, revenue protection and payment-cost assurance, and the modeling of contact center labor needs. You will partner with Payments, Customer Service, Subscriptions, Risk, Data, Financial Engineering, Accounting, and Business leadership to translate complex operational economics into clear financial narratives, build the models that inform decisions, and govern performance against plan.

lists.content:
• Payments Forecast Process Own the end-to-end payments forecast — including processing fees, vendor mix, and refunds — across monthly, quarterly, and annual planning cycles. Build and maintain driver-based models, analyse variances against forecast, and clearly explain the underlying drivers to leadership.
  • Payment Deal Making & Partner Value Serve as the finance lead on payment partner, processor, and payment-method agreements. Model deal economics, pricing tiers, volume commitments, and incentive structures; quantify margin and cash-flow impact; and maximise the value of strategic partnerships while driving cost efficiencies at scale alongside Payments, Legal, and Business Development.
  • Payment Optimisation & AI/ML Build business cases for payment optimisation initiatives — routing, retry logic, local payment methods, fee reduction, and authorisation-rate improvements, including ML-driven optimisation. Size the opportunity, define success metrics, and track realised impact against the original investment case.
  • Checkout Flow Build business cases for checkout experience investments, partnering with Product and Engineering to evaluate the financial impact of flow changes on conversion, payment success rates, and subscriber acquisition costs.
  • Regional & Local Payment Methods Partner with regional payments leads to evaluate the economics of local payment methods, prioritise market-level investments, and align regional performance with global priorities.
  • Revenue Protection & Risk Provide the financial lens on revenue protection and payment risk — fraud, authentication, disputes and chargebacks, and reselling — quantifying the trade-off between loss mitigation, margin, and genuine-user experience, and supporting the business case for risk and regulatory readiness.
  • Payment Cost Assurance Partner with Financial Engineering and Data Science to verify and reconcile payment fees, detect fee anomalies, and build the automation, tooling, and alerting that improve cost visibility and forecasting accuracy.
  • Customer Service Forecast Process Own the customer service forecast across monthly, quarterly, and annual planning cycles — contact volumes, channel mix, cost-to-serve, and outsourced and in-house support spend. Analyse variances against plan and clearly explain the drivers to leadership.
  • Contact Centre Labour & Vendor Management Build and maintain workforce models that translate forecasted contact volumes, handle times, and service-level targets into headcount, staffing, and labour cost. Manage the economics of the BPO/vendor portfolio and site mix across geographies, and run scenario analysis for ramp-ups, seasonality, capacity, and efficiency initiatives.
  • Service Automation & Deflection Economics Quantify the financial impact of self-service, automation, and AI-driven deflection on contact volume and cost-to-serve, and build the business cases that balance efficiency against customer experience.
  • Performance Governance Establish and own the reporting infrastructure for payments and customer service. Develop and track KPIs covering cost of payments, acceptance rates, cost-to-serve, and the long-term unit economics of both functions.
  • Strategic Partnership Act as the primary finance partner to the Payments and Customer Service organisations, providing scenario analysis and decision support on roadmap prioritisation, market expansion, staffing strategy, and infrastructure investment.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership Partner with Data and Engineering teams to improve forecasting accuracy and cost visibility, and translate operational data into financial insight for non-technical stakeholders across Spotify.

• Experienced Finance Professional: 5+ years in FP&A, Corporate Development, Investment Banking, or strategic finance. Experience in payments, fintech, subscriptions, customer service/contact centre operations, or other transaction- and labour-intensive businesses is highly preferred.
  • Sophisticated Modeller: You build dynamic, driver-based models that handle complex variables — fee structures, payment-method mix, FX, fraud and dispute rates, contact volumes, handle times, and staffing requirements — and distil them into the assumptions that matter most for a decision.
  • Deal-Oriented: You can structure and evaluate commercial agreements, pressure-test pricing and incentive terms, and clearly articulate trade-offs to senior stakeholders.
  • Clear Communicator & Influencer: You have a sharp eye for detail and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Finance and the business through clear, data-driven narratives and investment cases.
  • Operational Mindset: You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and building processes from scratch in a fast-paced, flat organisational structure.
  • Systems Fluency: Comfortable with automated reporting and planning tools (NetSuite/Adaptive, Workday Financials), strong SQL or data fluency, and a track record of leveraging AI and ML to drive analytical throughput and optimisation.

• This role is based in London or New York.
  • We offer flexibility to work where you work best, with 2–3 days per week in the office.
  • Collaboration hours align to the EST time zone.

lists.content:

  • Build and stress-test business cases that account for Spotify’s licensing structure, local market dynamics, currency considerations, and subscriber economics.

  • You are comfortable building and owning complex financial models, including unit economics, margin analysis, scenario modeling, and cannibalization frameworks.
  • You understand the dynamics of high-growth consumer markets and have experience working across different markets or geographies.
  • You can translate complex commercial trade-offs into clear, compelling narratives for senior audiences.
  • You work effectively across functions and levels, building alignment while constructively challenging assumptions.
  • You balance analytical rigor with sound judgment and are comfortable moving between detailed analysis and broader strategic thinking.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify is looking for a Marketing Manager to lead our marketing strategy and execution in Taiwan. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who can set strategy, lead integrated campaigns, create scroll-stopping social content, and make Spotify one of the most talked-about brands in one of Asia's most vibrant music markets.
Taiwan is the birthplace of Mandopop and a cultural tastemaker for the broader Chinese-speaking world. Growing the Spotify brand and business in this market demands genuine cultural fluency, a deep understanding of what resonates across social platforms, strong relationships within the music and creative industries, and the ability to turn insights into bold, locally relevant campaigns that grow our listener base and strengthen our connection with fans and artists.
Reporting to the SEA Head of Marketing, you'll work closely with cross-functional teams across Taiwan and the wider region to shape strategy, deliver impactful campaigns, and represent the Taiwan market at a regional and global level.
You'll partner with teams across Music, Growth, Communications, Business Development, Partnerships, and other functions to bring Spotify's brand to life in Taiwan and help unlock new opportunities for growth.

lists.content:

  • Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, out-of-home, experiential, and earned media with ideas designed to spark conversation and deliver measurable business impact

  • Manage the Taiwan marketing budget, prioritizing investments that deliver the greatest impact
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creative, media, production, and agency partners to consistently deliver high-quality work
  • Act as the voice of the Taiwan market, influencing regional and global stakeholders on campaign strategy, creative development, and market priorities

  • You have deep knowledge of Taiwan's music, entertainment, and cultural landscape, including Mandopop, emerging artists, internet culture, and local media
  • You have successfully led integrated marketing campaigns from strategy through execution that delivered measurable business results
  • You have created or led campaigns and social content that generated outsized reach, engagement, or cultural conversation relative to budget
  • You know how to use data and customer insights to develop business cases, evaluate campaign performance, and optimize future marketing investments

  • You have exceptional storytelling instincts and understand how to create culturally relevant campaigns that resonate with Taiwanese audiences

description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager who will join the Play Product Area within the Core Experience Studio to help evolve the experience of audio and media playback on Spotify. You will help define and evolve the experiences that make playing on Spotify more engaging, rewarding, and valuable for users, creators, and Spotify. Above all, your work will impact how hundreds of millions users experience music and media.

lists.content:
• Work with a cross-functional team that looks after our audio playback capabilities

  • Work with engineering, design, data science and user research to ensure the experience is scalable, usable, and useful for a range of strategies

  • Lead multiple projects across the entire product lifecycle

  • Triangulate data and insights to develop a robust product strategy and inform decision-making as well as short- and long-term roadmaps

  • Manage cross-functional and cross-org relationships to keep teams and leaders informed, receive input, and influence their thinking

• You are an experienced product manager with the ability to work with cross-functional teams, lead complex projects across multiple strategies and stakeholders, and make data-driven decisions

  • You are an expert in audio experiences, with a strong understanding of both the engineering aspects of audio processing and editing, as well as their impact on the user listening experience. For example, you understand how features like crossfading and beatmatching influence the flow and feel of an audio session, while also ensuring high overall audio quality

  • Experience from developing video playback experiences (in addition to audio) is a plus; e.g. low-latency video delivery, DRM, and optimizing playback for improved QoE

  • You have led the product work of several products in large tech companies that you can tell us about

  • You have a deep understanding of product practices and know how to incorporate multiple different perspectives (including user research, data and strategy) into one single product vision and experience

  • You care about creating engaging, rewarding, and valuable experiences for users, creators, and Spotify

• This role is based in Stockholm or London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify’s Legal team is growing. We’re facing innovative challenges that mirror the ground-breaking industry and product at the heart of our company. As we’ve expanded into more than 184 countries and our company has grown tremendously, we find ourselves facing new and interesting legal issues every day.
Legal Affairs sits at the heart of this mission, ensuring that Spotify meets its obligations under an evolving global regulatory landscape while championing user safety, transparency, and trust.
Spotify’s Product & Regulatory team within Legal Affairs leads the company’s global approach to digital-platform regulation. We drive the operational backbone of Spotify's approach to digital-platform regulation—managing the workflows, documentation, and cross-functional coordination needed to comply with laws like the EU Digital Markets Act (DMA), EU Digital Services Act (DSA), the UK Online Safety Act (UK OSA), the Australian Online Safety Act (AUS OSA), and similar frameworks worldwide. Working closely with Legal stakeholders, Trust & Safety, Public Policy, Product, Design, and Engineering, we turn regulatory requirements into well-managed processes and keep them on track.
We’re looking for a resourceful operator who can own the day-to-day machinery of our product and regulatory compliance work—document management, regulatory monitoring, terms updates, and cross-functional special projects. If you’re a self-starter who thrives on bringing order to complexity and keeping programs moving, we’d love to hear from you.

lists.content:

  • Build and maintain regulatory monitoring practices—tracking legislative developments, managing regulatory calendars, and surfacing changes that matter to the team.
  • Manage terms-of-service and policy update processes end-to-end—coordinating drafts, cross-functional reviews, approvals, and publication timelines.
  • Project-manage special projects and cross-functional initiatives for the Product & Regulatory Legal team, driving workstreams from kick-off to close with clear milestones and owners.
  • Support responses to regulatory requests for information (RFIs) and audits—pulling together materials, coordinating inputs across teams, and ensuring timely, accurate submissions.
  • Develop and maintain internal playbooks, process documentation, and communications that keep compliance workflows running without bottlenecks.
  • Coordinate with Product, Trust & Safety, and Engineering to keep operational controls and reporting processes on track across active regulatory programs.
  • Identify operational gaps and drive continuous improvement in how the team manages its regulatory workload.

• You have 5+ years’ experience in operations, program management, or legal operations in a tech, digital-platform, or media environment.
  • Familiarity with online-platform regulation (DMA, DSA, UK OSA, AUS OSA, COPPA) is a plus but not required—you’ll learn fast.
  • A proven project manager who can juggle competing deadlines, keep stakeholders aligned, and drive programs to completion.

  • Resourceful and scrappy—you figure things out, build the process, and don’t wait to be told what to do.
  • Skilled at document management, knowledge organization, and building the operational infrastructure a team needs to move fast.
  • Comfortable working across global time zones and cultures in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • Experience with project management tools (Jira, Asana, Notion, or similar) and a bias toward structured execution over ad-hoc work.

• This role is based in New York, NY.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

descriptionBody:

Your work will bring platform thinking together with real human impact, helping our advisors do their best work and improving how users experience Spotify support.

Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way.
Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. As AI agents increasingly generate code, write data pipelines, and power personalized user experiences, Data Platform sits at the center of one of the most important infrastructure domains at Spotify.
We're looking for a passionate Product Manager to join the team responsible for Spotify’s data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage capabilities. In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and product teams across Spotify to make working with data faster, safer, and more intuitive.

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.
Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

lists.content:
Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:
 
Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.
 
Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.
 
Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.
 
You will also:
  • Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.
  • Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.
  • Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.
  • Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.

• You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Previous industry experience is helpful.
  • You have experience in one or more of the following fields: generative modeling, machine learning, music information retrieval, speech processing, audio processing, signal processing, probabilistic modeling, computer vision, or related areas.
  • You have deep expertise in at least one of the focus areas above—whether that's vocal/speech synthesis, post-training alignment techniques (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DPO), or audio-to-audio generation and text-guided music editing.
  • You have publications at leading conferences such as ICASSP, ISMIR, INTERSPEECH, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, or related venues.
  • You have strong coding skills in Python, PyTorch, and NumPy.
  • You are a creative problem solver who is passionate about building outstanding products that add real value to millions of people.
  • You are enthusiastic about turning research ideas into products operating at scale.
  • You can explain complex topics in simple terms, and you enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.
  • This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.
  • Core working hours are CET 3pm-6pm / EST 9am-12pm.

descriptionPlain:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
Spotify’s Personalization organization builds the technology that helps millions of listeners discover what they love. Within this space, our research team focuses on advancing the state of the art in machine learning and AI to shape the future of personalization. We explore new approaches, challenge existing assumptions, and contribute to the broader research community while influencing long-term product direction.

  • Contribute to the scientific community through publications, talks, and conference participation

  • Help define and evolve a forward-looking research agenda aligned with Spotify’s personalization strategy

  • You have deep knowledge of machine learning, with experience in areas such as recommender systems, generative models, or representation learning
  • You are experienced in designing experiments and working with real-world datasets to validate research ideas
  • You care about advancing understanding of user behavior and improving experiences across music and talk content
  • You bring curiosity, creativity, and a thoughtful approach to solving complex, open-ended problems
  • You value collaboration and actively seek diverse perspectives in your work

• This role is based in New York City or Boston
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

descriptionPlain:
The Subscriptions Mission team focuses on building the systems and experiences that help Spotify acquire, convert, and retain subscribers around the world. The team works across product, engineering, and data to power Spotify’s subscription offerings, ensuring seamless purchase, billing, and customer service experiences for millions of users globally.
The Subscriptions team sits at the heart of Spotify’s business, powering how millions of users subscribe and stay connected to the platform. Within this mission, the Commerce Platform team builds and operates the backend systems that enable purchases, billing, invoicing, and payments globally. You’ll join a collaborative environment where engineers, product managers, and data practitioners work together to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-impact financial infrastructure.

descriptionPlain:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Subscriptions Mission. This team oversees the entire user journey on Spotify and ensures we engage with people in innovative ways, every step of the way. Our team grows Spotify’s audience by finding future listeners around the world and delivering the right value to them, at the right time. With research, product development, product design, engineering, and marketing all collaborating in one organization, we’re able to quickly create meaningful features and services for millions of people around the world, resulting in joyful, long-lasting relationships with Spotify.
 
As a Senior Backend Engineer you will participate in building and maintaining the systems responsible for driving user conversion, retention and upsells together with other R&D teams, Marketing and Growth. The team is uniquely positioned to play a key role in a new effort to strengthen our platform capabilities in this area to support the rapidly growing business needs of the ever-changing product portfolio.
 
We are moving towards a more user focused, contextual conversion, retention and upsell experience that is less manually operated, and more consistent across channels, using levers like machine learning and personalisation. We want to solve this through a platformised approach utilising new systems for decision-making on what we want users to see combined with a content management solution that can handle all the necessary complexities.

lists.content:

  • Collaborate with other squads, engineering managers and product managers to identify and solve challenging problems, to successfully scale our automation and new platform capabilities.

descriptionPlain:
We’re looking for a Senior C++/iOS Engineer to join the Baldur squad within User Platform (UP). Baldur owns Spotify’s Session Management and Delegated Authorization domains—the systems that enable applications to securely obtain, use, and manage access tokens for hundreds of millions of users. In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration. 
Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.
description:
We’re looking for a Senior C++/iOS Engineer to join the Baldur squad within User Platform (UP). Baldur owns Spotify’s Session Management and Delegated Authorization domains—the systems that enable applications to securely obtain, use, and manage access tokens for hundreds of millions of users. In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration. 

Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.

lists.content:
• Collaborate with a highly autonomous and supportive engineering squad responsible for Spotify’s delegated authorization and session management platforms.
  • Design, build, and evolve critical infrastructure powering Spotify applications and partner integrations using shared C++ libraries and native Swift on iOS.
  • Develop secure, reliable, and performant delegated authorization flows, including token issuance, refresh, revocation, and session lifecycle management across multiple platforms.
  • Partner with client and backend engineers to integrate with core authorization services, token issuance, client registration, and token revocation.
  • Improve how credentials and access tokens are securely stored and managed on-device while balancing security, reliability, and application performance.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Spotify’s authorization frameworks, Spotify-specific implementations, enabling new platforms and product experiences.
  • Drive technical improvements, share knowledge with teammates, and help shape the long-term technical direction of delegated authorization and session management.

• You have strong proficiency in C++, along with experience building native iOS applications in Swift, or you're excited to develop your expertise in Swift while applying your C++ skills.
  • You have experience designing, building, or maintaining security-sensitive systems such as authorization, authentication, token management, credential storage, or related platforms.
  • You bring a systems-thinking mindset and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges that span client and backend technologies.
  • You have a solid understanding of software architecture, secure system design, and modern authorization protocols such as OAuth 2.0.
  • You approach problems thoughtfully, with strong attention to detail and a focus on building secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with engineers across multiple teams and technical disciplines.
  • You have experience working with shared cross-platform codebases and understand how native platform layers interact with common C++ libraries.
  • You enjoy working on large-scale distributed systems where your contributions improve experiences for hundreds of millions of Spotify users.

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

lists.content:

  • Build systems that collect and process user behaviour data at scale.
  • Help power Spotify’s personalization and recommendation systems, as well as the tools teams use to build and test new features.
  • Design and evolve data architectures that support high data volumes and a broad range of internal users.
  • Improve the reliability, scalability, and usability of our data infrastructure.
  • Work across disciplines to solve complex data challenges and make an impact across Spotify.

• You are an experienced Data Engineer, and proficient in backend development using Java.
  • You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets using SQL and platforms such as BigQuery.
  • You have experience with JVM-based data processing frameworks such as Flink, Beam, Dataflow, or Spark.
  • You are familiar with DevOps practices, cloud infrastructure, containerized applications, and Kubernetes fundamentals.
  • You have experience with data modeling and schema design.
  • You care about high-quality code and engineering practices such as continuous delivery and automated testing.
  • You value experimentation, iterative development, and collaborative software development practices.

• This role is based in London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work, creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Our team builds Groove, a platform that helps thousands of employees plan, coordinate, and deliver work across Spotify. From initiative tracking to dependency management and collaborative planning, Groove helps teams stay aligned and execute with confidence.

We're a small, cross-functional engineering team focused on building thoughtful tools that reduce friction and help people do their best work. We move quickly, learn from user feedback, and continuously improve the experiences we build.

lists.content:
• Build and evolve Groove, a fullstack platform that supports planning, collaboration, and execution across Spotify.
  • Design and deliver features including initiative tracking, planning workflows, and dependency management.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify’s Subscriptions Mission focuses on converting listeners into lifelong subscribers by delivering seamless, valuable experiences across pricing, packaging, and customer journeys. We build the systems and tools that power acquisition, retention, and overall subscription growth at scale.
The Messaging Platform powers Spotify’s communications to over a billion users — from push notifications to emails and in-app messages that connect listeners to the content they love. Within this space, the Paloma squad focuses on message optimization: deciding which message reaches which user, through which channel, and at what moment.
We’re evolving how messaging works at Spotify — moving from short-term optimization toward systems that understand long-term user journeys. By combining reinforcement learning approaches with deeper domain signals, we’re expanding how machine learning shapes the entire messaging funnel.

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Policy & Safety team sits within Content Platform in the Experience Mission, building the systems that keep Spotify safe, compliant, and trusted by millions of users and creators. This team owns Spotify’s content moderation infrastructure — from detection models to policy enforcement systems and compliance data pipelines.
Working at the intersection of machine learning, platform engineering, and regulatory compliance, the team partners closely with Trust & Safety, Legal, and Public Affairs. They’re on the critical path for every new content type and social feature — including messaging, comments, and collaborative experiences — ensuring safety is built in from day one. With a strong focus on “safety by default,” the team is investing in large-scale rearchitecture and ML-driven systems to proactively protect users and empower safer interactions across the platform.

lists.content:

  • Work on the priority public policy issues affecting Spotify in the EU - with a focus on platforms and content regulation, consumer rules, as well as trade and tech regulation in general. You will be responsible for managing these files and developing and implementing effective advocacy strategies. 
  • Work closely with other groups and departments inside Spotify -- including legal, licensing, communications, social impact, compliance and trust and safety -- to understand the priorities of internal partners, and create approaches to key policy issues that advance the interests of Spotify
  • Develop engagement and partnerships with external organizations such as trade associations and civil society organizations

• 10+ years of experience in EU government affairs, for a government/public authority, a company, and/or a trade association
  • Expertise on regulatory issues, especially in the field of platform and consumer regulation
  • Excellent understanding of tech sector and policy, and ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues
  • Mastering of AI tools, such as Claude, Chat GPT, Gemini
  • Strong written and oral communications skills & attention to detail
  • Ability to work with a cross section of stakeholders, including trade associations, companies, civil society
  • Ability to work independently, across time zones and cultures 
  • Full English language proficiency is required
  • Knowledge of an additional EU language (e.g. Dutch, Polish) is a positive asset

• This role is based in our Brussels offices
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 days per Week.

descriptionPlain:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Editor for Indonesia, to join Spotify’s Music Editorial team based in Jakarta. In this role you will be part of the Music team in Southeast Asia, reporting to the regional Head of Editorial.
You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, including playlist curation, creative editorial work, and cross-functional collaboration with different teams in the region and beyond. You will provide deep cultural and musical insights to create highly engaging and cohesive music experiences for listeners, extending beyond playlists, while ensuring an unbiased editorial voice for a wide array of moods, moments, and genres. Additionally, you will drive artist discovery through an extensive editorial ecosystem of playlists and tools, critically assessing music trends and user behavior to identify opportunities and emerging trends.
You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify’s role in the music industry both locally and globally. Additionally, you will have an editorial personality that thrives in engaging audiences through creative formats, bringing the playlists to life in innovative ways.
You will be encouraged to make data-informed decisions while also contributing creative and cultural expertise. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape!

You will provide deep cultural and musical insights to create highly engaging and cohesive music experiences for listeners, extending beyond playlists, while ensuring an unbiased editorial voice for a wide array of moods, moments, and genres. You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify’s role in the music industry both locally and globally. Additionally, you will have an editorial personality that thrives in engaging audiences through creative formats, bringing the playlists to life in innovative ways.

You will be encouraged to make data-informed decisions while also contributing creative and cultural expertise. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape!

lists.content:
• Develop and execute a holistic editorial strategy for Indonesia that aligns with regional business goals
  • Shape and evolve our editorial voice across playlists, written and visual storytelling, and short-form content on and off platform
  • Pioneer creative and innovative formats to bring playlists to life and deepen connection with listeners
  • Proactively identify music trends, emerging talent, and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, acting as a cultural guide
  • Curate cohesive, engaging playlists for Indonesia with compelling descriptions and commentary that resonate with audiences
  • Lead editorial representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets at both a regional and global level with teams like artist & label partnerships, marketing, design, PR, and product
  • Maintain and refine a strong playlist ecosystem that supports artist discovery and deepens artist-fan engagement
  • Analyze user behavior and performance data to optimize playlist engagement and make informed editorial decisions, translating high-level insights into actionable initiatives
  • Collaborate with global and regional editorial teams on programming initiatives and strategies to enhance Spotify’s market position.

• At least 8+ years of experience in the music industry, journalism, programming/curating music for digital, radio, TV, or other media outlets
  • You have deep knowledge of music and culture, possessing broad expertise across all genres and styles, from Indo Pop to HipDut, Indie to Javanese music, with the ability to curate music for diverse moods and moments
  • Skilled at leveraging data and audience insights to support editorial decisions and build clear narratives
  • You have a strong editorial voice and are culturally aware, with the ability to critically evaluate music trends, emerging movements, and audience behavior beyond just data
  • A confident storyteller and public speaker, fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia to effectively advocate for the market and secure stakeholder buy-in
  • An excellent communicator, capable of connecting with audiences through written, video, or audio commentary to enhance playlists
  • You’re a team player who is detail-oriented and consistently demonstrates a positive attitude, adaptable and at ease navigating fast-changing priorities in a dynamic environment, comfortable navigating complex global-to-local organizational structures and aligning cross-functional teams around Editorial priorities
  •  You are curious about how technology and culture intersect, constantly exploring new, innovative formats to keep Spotify at the forefront of the cultural zeitgeist
  • You are comfortable on-camera and experienced crafting social-first content and working with video production teams
  • You are knowledgeable of Google Suite tools, comfortable with basic design tools and workflows, capable of creating visual assets like playlist covers when necessary.

• This role is based in Jakarta
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience - end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager to help lead the audiobook experience across Spotify’s mobile apps. You’ll join Format Foundations within Core Experience and partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to shape how listeners discover, evaluate, enjoy, and build lasting relationships with audiobooks on Spotify.

lists.content:
• Lead product strategy for Spotify’s audiobook experience, shaping how the format becomes more engaging, valuable, and enjoyable for listeners, creators, and the business.
  • Define and evolve the experience across the audiobook journey, from discovery and evaluation through playback, library management, and reading.
  • Partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to translate business strategy and listener needs into product innovation that supports growth.
  • Drive innovation across multimodal experiences, including the intersection of listening and reading.
  • Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, and other cross-functional teams to deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences at scale.
  • Use data, experimentation, and user insights to make informed product decisions and continuously improve the experience.
  • Build alignment across Core Experience, Audiobooks, Personalization, and other partners to create a cohesive Spotify experience.
  • Lead complex cross-functional initiatives end to end, setting direction and scope, creating alignment, and partnering with Engineering on delivery.

• You have 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful experience with audiobook, ebook, digital reading, or related consumer products.
  • You have a deep understanding of the audiobook or digital reading landscape, including user behavior, publisher ecosystems, and competitive dynamics.
  • You have experience building consumer products for mobile platforms such as iOS and Android, including complex user experiences.
  • You understand how to build scalable systems and experiences that help teams move faster.
  • You know how to balance user needs, technical considerations, and business impact when making product decisions.
  • You care deeply about creating intuitive, high-quality consumer experiences at scale.
  • You have partnered closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and other disciplines to bring products from strategy through delivery.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, making thoughtful trade-offs, and creating clarity across teams.
  • You can influence stakeholders across functions and levels to build alignment and drive meaningful outcomes.
  • You actively use AI tools in your product development workflow, including for research, analysis, iteration, and prototyping.

• This role is based in Stockholm or London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description:
Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.

This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.

lists.content:
• Own the product strategy and roadmap for how free users become aware of, experience, and develop intent for Premium, driving consideration, conversion intent, and subscriber growth across segments and markets.
  • Lead the discovery, design, and delivery of subscriber-facing features from early concept through global rollout.
  • Drive experiments that deepen our understanding of what makes users want Premium and measurably move free users closer to a purchase decision.
  • Turn behavioral, funnel, and market data into clear hypotheses, define meaningful success metrics, and build a prioritized experimentation roadmap.
  • Design rigorous A/B experiments to evaluate funnel changes against strong baselines, scaling approaches that demonstrably work across markets and segments.
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs across user value, revenue impact, regional nuance, and operational complexity, knowing when a simple flow change is enough and when a deeper platform capability is needed.
  • Partner with marketing, research, and regional teams to adapt value positioning and messaging for different markets, competitive landscapes, and user needs, including high-growth emerging markets where the path to Premium may look fundamentally different.
  • Communicate strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders, translating funnel mechanics and subscription economics into business impact and strategic direction.

• You have a strong track record in product management and have shipped consumer-facing products or features at scale, with experience that translates well to subscription, marketplace, consumer growth, or media environments.
  • You have strong instincts for consumer value and what makes a product feel worth paying for, and understand how perception, positioning, and product experience work together to influence willingness to pay.
  • You can break down the path from awareness to conversion, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and connect product decisions to downstream revenue outcomes such as ARPU, LTV, and net subscriber growth.
  • You're fluent in experimentation and A/B testing and are confident interpreting funnel, cohort, and behavioral analysis to make thoughtful prioritization decisions.
  • You know how to navigate the complexity of a global consumer business across different segments, markets, and competitive dynamics, balancing global consistency with local relevance.
  • You bring strong judgment about when to optimize, when to invest more deeply, and when to leave something alone, balancing user value, revenue impact, and operational cost.
  • You're a clear communicator and collaborative partner across product, design, engineering, marketing, research, data science, and regional teams, and you can align people around shared outcomes.
  • You're comfortable working through open-ended problems, learning quickly through experimentation, and adapting your approach based on evidence.

• This role is based in London, United Kingdom or Stockholm, Sweden.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective — including voice type, age and gender — and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more.
As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs?

As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs?

lists.content:
• Own the quality bar for Spotify’s AI voice models, defining what “good enough” means for different products, audiences, languages and use cases.
  • Independently design evaluation rubrics and build an evaluation approach that measures qualities such as naturalness, tone, pacing, pronunciation, accent, audio quality and overall experience.
  • Plan and carry out evaluation campaigns, turning qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for Voice Production, Speak and product teams.
  • Establish an ongoing evaluation rhythm, including when and how we reassess model quality as our technology and products evolve.
  • Benchmark Spotify’s AI voices against third-party models and competitors to understand where our experiences lead, where they differ and where there are opportunities to improve.
  • Help determine appropriate quality trade-offs as Spotify expands into additional languages and regions, considering the product use case and needs of each market.
  • Partner closely with voice experts, machine learning teams, product partners and vendors to maintain a consistent quality bar across demanding and sometimes competing priorities.
  • Surface the most meaningful gaps in model performance and use evaluation insights to help influence future research and technical priorities.

• You have experience in product quality, evaluation, data curation or a closely related field where human judgment is used to assess model or product performance.
  • You know how to independently define evaluation criteria and turn subjective qualities into clear, repeatable rubrics.
  • You are comfortable designing and running both qualitative and MOS-style evaluations and synthesizing the results into actionable insights.
  • You have an understanding of voice or audio quality, including qualities such as naturalness, pacing, tone, accent and pronunciation, or the ability to develop that expertise quickly.
  • You have strong judgment and can maintain a consistent quality bar while balancing different product requirements, markets and stakeholder perspectives.
  • You are comfortable working autonomously, identifying what needs to be evaluated and establishing the processes and cadence to make that evaluation useful over time.
  • You communicate clearly across creative, technical and product teams and can act as a reliable point of contact for internal partners and external vendors.
  • You are curious about generative AI, speech technology and the evolving AI voice landscape and can translate changes in the industry into meaningful benchmarks for Spotify.

• This role is based in New York or Los Angeles.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

lists.content:
• Own the quality bar for Spotify’s AI voice models, defining what “good enough” means for different products, audiences, languages and use cases.
  • Independently design evaluation rubrics and build an evaluation approach that measures qualities such as naturalness, tone, pacing, pronunciation, accent, audio quality and overall experience.
  • Plan and carry out evaluation campaigns, turning qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for Voice Production, Speak and product teams.
  • Establish an ongoing evaluation rhythm, including when and how we reassess model quality as our technology and products evolve.
  • Benchmark Spotify’s AI voices against third-party models and competitors to understand where our experiences lead, where they differ and where there are opportunities to improve.
  • Help determine appropriate quality trade-offs as Spotify expands into additional languages and regions, considering the product use case and needs of each market.
  • Partner closely with voice experts, machine learning teams, product partners and vendors to maintain a consistent quality bar across demanding and sometimes competing priorities.
  • Surface the most meaningful gaps in model performance and use evaluation insights to help influence future research and technical priorities.

• You have experience in product quality, evaluation, data curation or a closely related field where human judgment is used to assess model or product performance.
  • You know how to independently define evaluation criteria and turn subjective qualities into clear, repeatable rubrics.
  • You are comfortable designing and running both qualitative and MOS-style evaluations and synthesizing the results into actionable insights.
  • You have an understanding of voice or audio quality, including qualities such as naturalness, pacing, tone, accent and pronunciation, or the ability to develop that expertise quickly.
  • You have strong judgment and can maintain a consistent quality bar while balancing different product requirements, markets and stakeholder perspectives.
  • You are comfortable working autonomously, identifying what needs to be evaluated and establishing the processes and cadence to make that evaluation useful over time.
  • You communicate clearly across creative, technical and product teams and can act as a reliable point of contact for internal partners and external vendors.
  • You are curious about generative AI, speech technology and the evolving AI voice landscape and can translate changes in the industry into meaningful benchmarks for Spotify.

• This role is based in London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

This role offers exposure to a wide range of cross-functional teams and strategic initiatives.

lists.content:
• Coordinate accounting across Spotify’s Advertising Revenue business, including Programmatic, Direct-Sold, Podcast, and Emerging Ad Products.
  • Execute and review month-end close activities, including revenue and deferred revenue journal entries, account reconciliations, and fluctuation analyses.
  • Help ensure accurate and timely advertising financial reporting in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) control requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve how we work and partner with Engineering and business stakeholders to scope, test, and implement scalable accounting processes and system improvements.
  • Develop and refine revenue accounting processes for new advertising revenue streams, ad formats, platform integrations, and partnerships.
  • Partner with Technical Accounting, Finance, Legal, Sales, Sales Operations, FP&A, Accounts Receivable, Tax, Financial Engineering, and other teams on accounting and systems initiatives.
  • Prepare support for internal and external audits, assess accounting risks, and test system releases that affect advertising revenue reporting.
  • Support acquisitions, ERP and other system implementations, and special projects related to Spotify’s evolving advertising business.

• You have 4+ years of experience in revenue accounting, accounting operations, general ledger accounting, or public accounting, ideally within digital advertising, ad tech, digital media, entertainment, or another business operating at scale.
  • You have a bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent higher education; CPA or CA credentials are a plus.
  • You understand IFRS, revenue recognition principles, and accounting controls, with exposure to ITGC and/or SOX environments.
  • You have experience working with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system such as Oracle or SAP.
  • You are comfortable working with data and systems; experience with SQL, BigQuery, or AI-enabled tools is a plus.
  • You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can balance attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture.
  • You can manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work against deadlines, including during month-, quarter-, and year-end close.
  • You enjoy collaborating across teams and time zones and bring curiosity and adaptability to a changing business and technology environment.

• This role is based in New York.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
  • We ask that you come into the office 2–3 days per week.

description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Enterprise AI builds and operates the internal AI platform layer that supports Spotifiers across the company. We’re helping evolve AI tooling into reliable infrastructure that teams can use in their day-to-day work. Our team builds the connective tissue between AI models and Spotify’s internal systems, with a focus on secure access, governance, identity, integrations, and dependable AI infrastructure.

lists.content:
• Design, build, and operate secure enterprise AI platform capabilities that connect AI models, agents, tools, and Spotify’s internal systems.
  • Own major workstreams across our enterprise AI infrastructure, including our Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway and enterprise context capabilities, from technical design through launch and operation.
  • Build reliable backend services, APIs, and integrations that enable AI-powered experiences across Spotify’s digital workplace.
  • Help develop scalable approaches to AI governance, including identity-aware access, permissions, auditing, policy enforcement, and managing risks associated with third-party AI-enabled tools.
  • Design, build, test, and evaluate agentic systems and workflows that help Spotifiers access information and accomplish tasks effectively.
  • Take operational ownership of the services and components you build, balancing speed, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.
  • Partner with engineers and stakeholders across Spotify to identify opportunities, make thoughtful technical tradeoffs, and turn emerging AI needs into scalable platform capabilities.
  • Contribute to engineering practices, knowledge sharing, and AI fluency as we learn how to operate enterprise AI infrastructure at Spotify scale.

• You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building, testing, debugging, and operating reliable backend systems.
  • You are experienced with backend languages such as Python, Go, or similar and are comfortable designing APIs and integrations across complex systems.
  • You understand software architecture and how services, APIs, enterprise tools, and user-facing experiences fit together.
  • You have experience with identity and authentication concepts and technologies such as OAuth, SAML, or SCIM.
  • You have experience working with cloud infrastructure; familiarity with Google Cloud Platform is valuable.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, creating clarity, and independently making thoughtful technical tradeoffs.
  • You care about operational ownership and building dependable infrastructure that other teams and employees can rely on.
  • You enjoy experimentation, iteration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning in a collaborative engineering environment.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS or platform engineering, or with LLM integration patterns such as tool use, function calling, agentic workflows, or systems-level prompt engineering, will help you make an impact in this role.

• This role is based in New York.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
 
At Spotify, we’re building the best way to experience audio and video — everywhere, every time. As listening and watching on TV continues to grow, we’re investing deeply in native, video-first playback experiences that are fast, reliable, and feel effortless.
 
The Native Playback team sits at the heart of Spotify’s TV strategy. We integrate Spotify’s playback experience with the native players and media frameworks available on each platform. Our work happens close to the system — where performance, reliability, and quality truly matter — and directly impacts how millions of people experience Spotify every day.

The Native Playback team sits at the heart of Spotify’s TV strategy. We integrate Spotify’s playback experience with the native players and media frameworks available on each platform. Our work happens close to the system — where performance, reliability, and quality truly matter — and directly impacts how millions of people experience Spotify every day.

lists.content:
• Design, build, and evolve the C++ integration layer that powers Spotify’s audio and video playback on TV devices running our new Rust runtime
  • Integrate Spotify’s playback experience with platform-native media frameworks such as AVPlayer, ExoPlayer, or equivalent TV player stacks
  • Own critical playback areas including buffering strategies, playback state handling, A/V synchronization, adaptive bitrate configuration, track selection, and rendering paths
  • Debug complex performance and reliability issues across multiple layers — from application logic to OS-level frameworks and hardware acceleration
  • Partner closely with Playback platform teams and device teams to ensure shared APIs and designs translate cleanly into real-world TV implementations
  • Improve test coverage, tooling, and observability to detect regressions and speed up iteration cycles
  • Contribute to thoughtful technical design discussions and raise the bar for playback quality through code reviews and knowledge sharing

• You have strong of experience building low-level systems in C++, ideally within video, media, or playback domains
  • You have hands-on experience integrating native playback frameworks such as AVPlayer, ExoPlayer, vendor SDKs, or similar media stacks
  • You have a deep understanding of video playback fundamentals including codecs, streaming formats, adaptive bitrate (ABR), buffering behavior, and A/V synchronization trade-offs
  • You are comfortable working close to the OS and media framework layer and diagnosing issues that span multiple system boundaries
  • You have experience contributing to the design and evolution of scalable technical systems across platforms
  • You are confident debugging performance and reliability issues using logs, traces, profilers, and system diagnostics tools
  • You collaborate effectively across teams and communicate technical trade-offs clearly
  • You care deeply about delivering reliable, high-quality playback experiences for millions of users

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best. While some in-person collaboration is expected, you’ll also have the option to work from home.

lists.content:
• Lead analyses across user behavior and content data to shape product and strategy decisions.

  • Shape how we evaluate and improve content classification and taxonomy, with a particular focus on safety, combining analytical depth with a broader view of product and business needs.

  • Design evaluation frameworks, including sampling strategies, setting baselines, metrics, and annotation-based approaches, and guide how these methods are applied across the team.

  • Build scalable analytical foundations, including metrics, dashboards, and the data and context needed to enable effective self-serve analysis and agents.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations leadership to shape priorities and how data informs product strategy.

  • Raise the analytical bar across Product Insights through methodological leadership, mentorship, and by identifying opportunities to improve how we work with data across domains.

• You have deep experience as a product data scientist and have operated at Staff level or equivalent.

  • You have a strong foundation in statistics and experience designing evaluation and measurement approaches, including annotation-based methods and settings where controlled experiments are not feasible.

  • You have experience in building metrics and reporting systems that support product or policy decision-making.

  • You have built self-serve analytical tools or data agents that enable others to answer questions effectively.

  • You are proficient in SQL and experienced with Python, DBT, or similar tools for building and maintaining reliable analytical datasets

  • You leverage state of the art LLM models to do your analysis while ensuring quality and accuracy in the output

  • You communicate clearly across functions, influence decisions with senior stakeholders, and help raise analytical standards through mentorship and methodological leadership.

  • You have experience working on content classification, taxonomy, safety, policy, or adjacent domains where data quality and judgment are important to product decisions.

• This role is based in Stockholm or London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The Experience team designs Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
The Content Intelligence Product Area is a core part of Spotify’s Content Platform within the Experience mission. We build systems that create deep, machine-readable understanding of content across audio, video, text, and images before it reaches users. This enables automation, safety, and entirely new product experiences. Our work powers content enrichment, quality analysis, annotation platforms, and scalable intelligence systems that allow teams across Spotify to build without needing direct content understanding expertise.
We’re now looking for a Staff Engineer to help build and scale foundational infrastructure powering content understanding across Spotify. This role sits at the intersection of backend systems, ML infrastructure, distributed data systems, and AI-enabled platform capabilities. You’ll help shape infrastructure strategy across the product area while partnering with senior engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional teams to execute on long-term technical investments.

lists.content:

  • Drive architectural decisions across distributed systems, ML infrastructure, data processing platforms, and platform reliability

  • Improve infrastructure supporting AI and LLM-enabled workflows, including podcast and audiobook transcript processing, metadata enrichment, and content understanding systems

  • Collaborate across organizational boundaries to drive alignment, technical quality, and long-term platform investments

description: Content Platform is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and delivering every piece of content on Spotify — from music and podcasts to audiobooks. Within Content Platform, the Media domain owns the end-to-end media pipeline, from the moment content arrives through to seamless playback for listeners around the world. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to provide architectural leadership across this media platform. You’ll help shape and drive the technical direction from ingestion through transcoding, packaging, storage, delivery, and playback. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, understands the trade-offs between codec choices and infrastructure costs, and can drive technical strategy across multiple teams at scale.

lists.content:
• Define and drive the long-term architectural direction for Spotify's media pipeline across Content Platform.
  • Lead large-scale technical initiatives that span multiple squads and organizations, including projects such as media delivery, codec rollouts, and future playback capabilities.
  • Partner closely with engineering managers, product managers, and senior engineers to align technical strategy with product priorities, reliability goals, and cost efficiency, acting as a key technical counterpart for media architecture.
  • Guide architectural decisions across media ingestion, transcoding, packaging, storage, content delivery, and playback.
  • Author and review RFCs, architecture decision records, and technical design documents that guide engineering teams and leadership.
  • Mentor senior engineers across the organization, helping raise technical quality, architectural thinking, and engineering excellence.
  • Bring a cost-aware engineering mindset by understanding how media architecture decisions impact compute, storage, CDN utilization, and long-term platform sustainability.

• You have deep expertise building large-scale media platforms spanning audio, video, encoding, transcoding, packaging, delivery, and playback technologies.

• This role is based in London or Stockholm
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionBody: Content Platform is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and delivering every piece of content on Spotify — from music and podcasts to audiobooks. Within Content Platform, the Media domain owns the end-to-end media pipeline, from the moment content arrives through to seamless playback for listeners around the world. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to provide architectural leadership across this media platform. You’ll help shape and drive the technical direction from ingestion through transcoding, packaging, storage, delivery, and playback. This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, understands the trade-offs between codec choices and infrastructure costs, and can drive technical strategy across multiple teams at scale.

lists.content:
• Help define and drive the Machine Learning engineering strategy for Discovery Mode and related royalty programs, translating product goals into scalable technical solutions.
  • Design, build, evaluate, ship, and refine production Machine Learning systems through hands-on development.
  • Provide technical leadership across complex ML initiatives, helping teams make thoughtful architectural and engineering decisions while balancing near- and long-term priorities.
  • Collaborate with user research, design, data science, product management, and engineering to build new product capabilities that strengthen connections between artists and fans.
  • Prototype new approaches and turn successful ideas into reliable, scalable solutions for Spotify for Artists customers.
  • Drive experimentation, optimization, testing, and tooling that improve the quality, reliability, and effectiveness of our Machine Learning systems.
  • Partner with engineers and Machine Learning practitioners across Spotify, including Music Tech Research and Personalization, to explore and develop new approaches to music promotion.
  • Help grow the technical capabilities of the broader engineering community through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and strong engineering practices.

• You have deep experience with Machine Learning and a strong understanding of Machine Learning algorithms, modeling approaches, evaluation, and experimentation.

  • You can set technical direction for complex ML problems while remaining close to implementation and delivery.
  • You care about reliable software, data-informed development, disciplined experimentation, and building systems that perform effectively at scale.
  • You enjoy leading technically complex projects from idea through production and working closely with teammates and partners to deliver meaningful outcomes.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, evaluating trade-offs, and creating clarity on high-impact initiatives.
  • You communicate technical decisions and risks clearly and can build alignment with senior technical leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • You care about creating products that better serve artists and their teams, and you take a collaborative, team-first approach to helping others do their best work.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North America region as long as we have a work location.
